'''Camos''' was the sixth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Utos]] in the [[Utos system|Galantos system]], located in the [[Farlax sector/Legends|Farlax sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Camos had twenty-one [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was one of the three [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="CW" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Utos system]], except [[Galantos]], were designed for the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Galantos star system in grid square K-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
